Description: Humans become exposed to malaria through contact with infectious mosquitoes.
Humans become exposed to malaria through non-vector means such as blood transfusion.
Vaccinated humans become exposed to malaria through contact with infectious mosquitoes.
Vaccinated humans become exposed to malaria through non-vector means.
Vector exposed humans progress to become infectious.
Non-vector exposed humans progress to become infectious.
Recovered humans lose immunity and become susceptible again.
Susceptible mosquitoes become exposed to malaria through contact with infectious humans.
Exposed mosquitoes progress to become infectious.
